stem: Based on this leaflet, which statement describes the methods used by the women's suffrage movement?

options.label: A
options.text: It aimed to achieve its goals with boycotts of major events.

options.label: B
options.text: It struggled with an organizing strategy for bringing together activists.

options.label: C
options.text: It hoped to draw public attention to the cause through mass protests.

options.label: D
options.text: It used illegal actions to force public recognition of its demands.

visual_elements: Votes for Women Inaugural Parade Washington, D.C., March 3, 1913 WHY YOU MUST MARCH Because this is the most conspicuous and important demonstration that has ever been attempted by suffragists in this country. Because this parade will be taken to indicate the importance of the suffrage movement by the press of the country and the thousands of spectators from all of the United States gathered in Washington for the Inauguration. —leaflet and pledge form, 'Votes for Women Inaugural Parade,' March 3, 1913
